tag.name: Notes
tag.description: Notes with versioning, attachments, and subject resolution.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:notes`

List notes for the tenant. Supports filtering by subject (`subject_type` + `subject_id`, or the `standalone` sentinel for notes with no subject), pinned state, author, agent, and a created-at time window (`since`/`until`). When a free-text query (`q`, max 256 characters) is supplied, results are ranked by full-text + trigram search; in that mode `next_cursor` is always null and `has_more` is the only continuation signal. The `standalone` subject filter cannot be combined with `subject_id` or with `q` (returns 400). Draft notes (photo-first flow) are excluded.

parameters.name: subject_type
parameters.description: Filter by subject type. The `standalone` sentinel matches notes with no attached subject (cannot be combined with `subject_id` or `q`).

parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.description: Filter by the id of the attached subject.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query (max 256 characters). Enables ranked search mode.

parameters.name: pinned
parameters.description: Filter by pinned state. Pass `true` or `false`.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Filter by the id of the user that created the note (`created_by`).

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Filter by the agent that created the note (`created_by_agent`).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only include notes created at or after this ISO-8601 datetime (inclusive lower bound).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only include notes created strictly before this ISO-8601 datetime (exclusive upper bound).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default 25, min 1, max 100).

200.description: A page of notes. Each note is enriched with its signed photo attachments.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results. Always null in search mode (`q` supplied) — use `has_more` instead.

has_more.description: True when more results exist beyond this page. In search mode this may be true while `next_cursor` is null, signalling truncation (refine the query).

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:notes`

Create a note. A note may be standalone (omit both `subject_type` and `subject_id`) or attached to a subject (supply both). Attaching a subject that does not exist in this tenant returns 404. The body may only be empty when `draft` is true (photo-first flow). Rate-limited per user (shared write bucket across create, update, and version-restore).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:notes`

Fetch a single non-deleted note by id.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:notes`

Update a note's body, pinned state, or attached subject, or commit a draft (`draft: false`). At least one field must be supplied. Subject fields are "both or neither": send both `subject_type` and `subject_id` (both non-null to attach, both null to detach). Attaching a subject that does not exist in this tenant returns 404.

Only the note's author or a tenant owner may update it; other tenant members receive 403. Rate-limited per user (shared write bucket across create, update, and version-restore).

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:notes`

Soft-delete a note. Only the note's author or a tenant owner may delete it; other tenant members receive 403.

204.description: The note was soft-deleted. No content.

NoteSubjectType.description: The kind of entity a note is attached to. `lawn_estimate` is a legacy alias that resolves to a quote.

NoteAttachment.description: A signed photo attachment on a note, as embedded in note list/detail rows.

signed_url.description: Time-limited signed URL to the stored image, or null when signing failed.

width.description: Image width in pixels, if known.

height.description: Image height in pixels, if known.

Note.description: A note. `subject_type` and `subject_id` are either both set (attached note) or both null (standalone note). List responses enrich each note with its `attachments`; the single-note GET returns the bare row without `attachments`.

subject_type.description: The kind of attached subject, or null for a standalone note.

subject_id.description: The id of the attached subject, or null for a standalone note.

body.description: Note body text (may be empty for an uncommitted draft).

created_by.description: Id of the user that created the note, or null for legacy/system notes.

created_by_agent.description: Identifier of the agent that created the note, if any.

updated_by.description: Id of the user that last updated the note, if any.

updated_by_agent.description: Identifier of the agent that last updated the note, if any.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete timestamp, or null when live.

attachments.description: Signed photo attachments. Present (possibly empty) on list responses; absent on the single-note GET.

NoteCreate.description: Payload to create a note. Supply both `subject_type` and `subject_id` to attach to a subject, or omit both for a standalone note. The body may only be empty when `draft` is true.

subject_id.description: Id of the subject to attach. Required if `subject_type` is set.

body.description: Note body text. Must be non-empty unless `draft` is true.

draft.description: Mark as a photo-first draft (allows an empty body). Drafts are excluded from list/search and reaped after 24h if not committed.

NoteUpdate.description: Payload to update a note. At least one field must be supplied. Subject fields are "both or neither" when present: both non-null to attach, both null to detach.

draft.description: Commit an in-progress draft. Only `false` is accepted.

subject_type.description: New subject type to attach, or null to detach. Must be sent together with `subject_id`.

subject_id.description: New subject id to attach, or null to detach. Must be sent together with `subject_type`.
